page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with a table of numbered rows in two columns (number and Greek letter, then a Greek letter column at right); running head at top; page number at top right. Greek headings and Greek lines in the centre. Faint show-through text from the reverse side is ignored.

main_text.head: Αλλη τάξις α, συλλεκτη τῶν ὅλων.
ἡ β, τῶτων ἀωλεκτη τῶν ὅλων.
ἡ γ, τῶτων τρισηκιλεκτη τῶν ὅλων.
main_text.p: Επἰα ἑτεραι συζυγίαι, αἵτινες ἐχσιν ἐν μονάδι μόνη ἐπίτασιν ἡ ἀνεσιν.

page.notes: Several numerals and Greek letters in the right-hand column are small and partly worn; the readings of the right column (e.g. ͵, ζ, η, θ) are doubtful. The last line's Greek is partly illegible. Show-through text from the reverse page is not transcribed.
